in_hebrew.name: יוסףאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יוסףאל הוא שם המשלב את השמות יוסף ואל, שפירושו אלוהים יוסף הוא. השם יוסף נגזר מהשורש י-ס-פ, שפירושו להוסיף או להגדיל. השם אל הוא קיצור של אלוהים, שפירושו האל העליון. לכן, השם יוסףאל פירושו אלוהים מוסיף או אלוהים הגדיל.

in_greek.name: Ιωσήφιλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιωσήφιλ είναι ένα όνομα που συνδυάζει τα ονόματα Ιωσήφ και Ηλ, που σημαίνει Ο Θεός προσθέτει. Το όνομα Ιωσήφ προέρχεται από τη ρίζα Ι-ω-σ-η-φ, που σημαίνει να προσθέτω ή να αυξάνω. Το όνομα Ηλ είναι συντόμευση του Θεού, που σημαίνει ο υπέρτατος Θεός. Επομένως, το όνομα Ιωσήφιλ σημαίνει Ο Θεός προσθέτει ή Ο Θεός μεγάλωσε.

in_latin.name: Yosephiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Yosephiel est nomen quod coniungit nomina Yoseph et El, quod significat Deus addit. Nomen Yoseph derivatur a radice Y-s-p-h, quod significat addere aut augere. Nomen El est abbreviatio Dei, quod significat Deum summum. Quapropter, nomen Yosephiel significat Deus addit aut Deus auxit.

in_english.name: Yosephiel
in_english.long_meaning: Yosephiel is a Christian name that combines the Hebrew names Yoseph (Joseph) and El (God). The name Yoseph is derived from the Hebrew root Y-s-p-h, meaning to add or increase. El is a shortened form of Elohim, meaning the supreme God. Therefore, Yosephiel means God adds or God increases. This name reflects the biblical theme of God's providence and abundance. Historically, the name Joseph has been significant in the Christian tradition, as Joseph was the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus. The name Yosephiel symbolizes spiritual growth, divine favor, and the blessings of God.

data.cultural_impact: The biblical character Yosef is a significant figure in Jewish and Christian cultures. He is a symbol of hope and forgiveness, whose story shows the power of faith, resilience, and the human capacity for kindness and redemption. His dreams, ambition, and the opposition he faced from his brothers and Egyptian master Potiphar are well-known tales still reverberating deeply in both faiths. In religious art, Yosef is often depicted as a strong, wise, and forgiving figure, which may have influenced the choice and meaning behind the name Yosephiel.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Yosephiel carries the spiritual significance of hope, faith, and the presence of God in our lives. Yosephiel means 'God will add' or 'God is help', emphasizing our belief that God walks alongside us, guiding us, and assisting us in life's challenges. It also serves as a reminder that even in the face of adversity, we should never lose faith and trust in the divine power of God, who ultimately helps us overcome our obstacles.
